response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS m FROM per), above AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_h FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_h > o.m), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS g FROM above) SELECT a.equipref AS equipref, a.avg_h AS avg_humidity, a.avg_h - o.m AS excess_over_all_avg, a.avg_h - g.g AS diff_from_group_mean FROM above a, overall o, grp g WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL AND g.g IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all equipment' is the mean of the per-equipment average humidities, so each piece of equipment counts equally regardless of how many readings it has.
Only equipment with at least one non-null humidity reading in scanenvironment is considered. Equipment with no readings has no average and is excluded.

The group mean is the mean of the per-equipment averages of the above-average equipment. Ranking by difference from the group mean is the same as ranking by average humidity, and ties are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-equipment average is the pooled average of every non-null humidity reading (each reading weighted equally), rather than the mean of per-equipment averages.
